The first full run found Django's migration-state guard requesting a proxy-model migration; this was resolved without a migration by using the required plain proxy_class condition class.

notes: No migration was added: the change creates no schema change and uses the existing Condition.proxy_class data field. The exact deployment mechanism is oscar.apps.offer.custom.create_condition(CategoryCondition, value=N), which persists the dotted class path; ConditionalOffer.condition.proxy() then loads that class and calls is_satisfied(offer, basket). RUN_METRICS.json is ignored as requested.
